findings.title: Command clear follows mapped handler return
findings.description: The mapped handler sets status 80 before copying. Caller 8000ECB8 clears command F02293 only after the handler returns. Require command zero, status, descriptor consistency, and a separate fresh readback. This ordering does not itself establish ownership.

findings.title: Selector-first Automatic handback
findings.description: FE requires override bit 6. Restoring a captured normal selector leaves FE and permits normal feedback without clearing permission first. Confirm manual flags zero, policy command idle, and all restored owned controls; do not infer settled PWM.

findings.title: Zero duty and measured stop are distinct
findings.description: FE copies zero unchanged and normal feedback also stores zero. Staged zero, actual PWM zero, coarse tachometer zero, and mechanical fan stop remain distinct.

findings.title: Exact model and physical boundary
findings.description: The companion source review establishes the official 0528 updater host 300/301 mailbox route. This data-only profile admits neither live writes nor other AMD models. Physical stop and recovery remain untested. Thermal tables are omitted because the existing SO6120 decoder uses a different manual-extension layout.
